title: B-tree clear table through cursor

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeClearTableOfCursor forwards an ephemeral cursor's owning Btree and root page to the table-clear owner while deliberately discarding the deleted-row count.

external_source_responsibilities: sqlite3BtreeClearTable / clearTable behavior and ephemeral cursor precondition
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete forwarding wrapper is assigned; full clearTable source translation remains independently open.

inputs: Cursor open on an ephemeral table
outputs: Exact clearTable success/error with deleted-row count discarded
contracts.ownership: Borrowed Cursor/Btree; table contents mutate through clearTable.
contracts.state_and_results: Forwards cursor.tree and cursor.root. Source passes null count output; Zig discards the returned count.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: clearTable owns B-tree/pager mutation; no additional callbacks.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Any clearTable error passes through; success leaves the table empty.

representation_differences: Zig clearTable returns the deleted-row count directly, which this wrapper explicitly discards instead of passing a null output pointer.

oracle.protocol: Compile and exercise the typed wrapper through an ephemeral cursor fixture; direct runtime fixture remains pending because current clearTable test paths call the underlying owner.
oracle.normalization: Deleted-row count is intentionally unobserved, matching null source output.

assurance.oom: Wrapper allocates nothing; clearTable allocation behavior external.
assurance.malformed_input: Non-ephemeral cursor violates documented source precondition.
assurance.continuation: Success preserves cursor owner/root while emptying table.
